title: Payment Account Setup
description: Create your payment account, verify your identity, and add a bank account to receive payouts — all in three simple steps.

endpoints.title: Create Your Account
endpoints.description: Enter your basic information and choose whether you're signing up as an individual or a business.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: We'll use this to contact you and for account login.

fields.name: fullName
fields.label: Full Name
fields.description: Your legal name as it appears on government-issued ID.

fields.name: accountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.description: Select the type that matches how you'll use this account.

endpoints.title: Verify Your Identity
endpoints.description: Provide the details we need to verify your identity. The fields shown depend on whether you chose an individual or business account in the previous step.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Enter your date of birth.

fields.name: governmentIdNumber
fields.label: Government ID Number
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Enter your government-issued identification number (e.g., SSN, passport number).

fields.name: residentialAddress
fields.label: Residential Address
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Enter your current home address.

fields.name: legalBusinessName
fields.label: Legal Business Name
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Enter the registered legal name of your business.

fields.name: taxIdNumber
fields.label: Tax ID Number
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Enter your business's tax identification number (e.g., EIN).

fields.name: businessRegistrationNumber
fields.label: Business Registration Number
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Enter your business's official registration number.

fields.name: businessAddress
fields.label: Business Address
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Enter your business's registered address.

fields.name: industryCategory
fields.label: Industry Category
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Select the industry that best describes your business.

endpoints.title: Add Payout Bank Account
endpoints.description: Enter your bank account details so we can send payouts to you. The account holder name should match the name you provided earlier.

fields.name: bankName
fields.label: Bank Name
fields.description: The name of your bank (e.g., Chase, Bank of America).

fields.name: accountHolderName
fields.label: Account Holder Name
fields.description: The name on the bank account. This should match your full name (individual) or legal business name (business) from step 1.

fields.name: routingNumber
fields.label: Routing Number
fields.description: Your bank's 9-digit routing number (ABA number in the US).

fields.name: payoutAccountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.description: Select whether this is a checking or savings account.
